-2-  NC: 2024:KHC:32660  CRL.P No. 7488 of 2024  THIS CRL.P IS FILED U/S. 438 CR.P.C PRAYING TO ENLARGE THE PETITIONER ON BAIL IN THE EVENT OF HIS ARREST IN CR.NO.106/2022 ADDL.CIVIL JUDGE (JR.DN) AND J.M.F.C COURT PAVAGADA TUMKUR (Y.N.HOSKOTE P.S) BY THE RESPONDENT POLICE FOR THE OFFENCE P/U/S 498(A),323,504,506 OF IPC AND SEC.3 AND 4 OF D.P ACT BY ALLOWING THIS PETITION.

THIS PETITION, COMING ON FOR ORDERS, THIS DAY, ORDER WAS MADE THEREIN AS UNDER:
CORAM: HON'BLE MR JUSTICE S VISHWAJITH SHETTY
ORAL ORDER 1

. Accused nos.5 to 7 are before this Court under Section 438 Cr.PC seeking anticipatory bail in Crime No.106/2022 registered by Y.N.Hosakote Police Station, Tumakuru District, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 323, 504, 506 IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961.
2. Heard the learned Counsel for the parties.
3. FIR in Crime No.106/2022 registered by Y.N.Hosakote Police Station, Tumakuru District, for the aforesaid offences against Ramanji and six others on the basis of the first information dated 25.10.2022 received from Krishnaveni W/o Ramanji.
Petitioners are arrayed as accused nos.5 to 7 in the FIR.
Apprehending arrest in the said case, petitioners had filed Crl. Misc. No.5048/2024 before the jurisdictional Sessions NC: 2024:KHC:32660 Court, which was rejected on 29.02.2024.
Therefore, they are before this Court.
4. Learned Counsel for the petitioners having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition, prays to allow the petition.
5. Per contra, learned HCGP has opposed the petition.

sentences.text: From a perusal of the order passed by the learned Sessions Judge in Crl. Misc. No.5048/2024, it is seen that the learned Sessions Judge has refused to grant anticipatory bail to the petitioners on the ground that the petitioners had not produced the order sheet of the Trial Court in Crime No.106/2022.
The learned Sessions Judge has expressed that warrant or proclamation orders might have been issued against the petitioners herein.
7. Petitioners have produced the order sheet of the Trial Court in the present case and perusal of the same would go to show that only summons has been issued to the accused.
Petitioners are arrayed as accused nos.5 to 7 in the FIR.

Learned Counsel for the petitioners has brought to the notice of this Court that accused nos.1 to 4 have been granted bail and NC: 2024:KHC:32660 the petitioners herein are the neighbourers of accused no.1.
He has also brought to the notice of this Court that the dispute between accused no.1 and the first informant is already settled.
Under the circumstances, I am of the opinion that the petitioners prayer for grant of anticipatory bail requires to be answered affirmatively.

Accordingly, the following order:
8. The petition is allowed.

The respondent - Police or any other police in the State of Karnataka are directed to release the petitioners in the event of their arrest in Crime No.106/2022 registered by Y.N.Hosakote Police Station, Tumakuru District, for the offences punishable under Sections 498A,
323, 504, 506 IPC and Sections 3 & 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act, 1961, subject to the following conditions:
1. The petitioners shall appear before the Investigating Officer within 15 days from the date of receipt of the copy of this order and shall execute a personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/-
each with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction of the investigating officer.
2. Petitioners shall regularly appear before the Trial Court without fail unless exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.
NC: 2024:KHC:32660 3. Petitioners shall not tamper with the prosecution witness and they shall co-
operate with the police for investigation and appear before them whenever called upon.
4. The petitioners shall not involve in similar offences in future.

Sd/-
